title: Nutty Pine Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe combining the flavors of nutty and pine with a hint of tunisian spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pine nuts and cook until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Add the green onions and bok choy. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and Tunisian spice blend.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
